tasks.label: LiteBox: Tail Audit Log
args: $dir = 'C:\src\litebox\target\litebox-audit'; Write-Host 'Watching audit logs in:' $dir -ForegroundColor DarkGray; $seen = @{}; $labels = @{}; $nextLabel = 0; while ($true) { if (Test-Path $dir) { Get-ChildItem $dir -Filter '*.jsonl' | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { $p = $_.FullName; if (-not $seen.ContainsKey($p)) { $seen[$p] = (Get-Content $p).Count; $lbl = [char]([int][char]'A' + ($nextLabel++ % 26)); $labels[$p] = $lbl; Write-Host "[$lbl] New session: $($_.Name)" -ForegroundColor Cyan }; $lbl = $labels[$p]; $lines = Get-Content $p; if ($lines.Count -gt $seen[$p]) { $lines[$seen[$p]..($lines.Count-1)] | ForEach-Object { if ($_ -match '^\{') { try { $o = $_ | ConvertFrom-Json; Write-Host "[$lbl] $($o.syscall)($($o.args | ForEach-Object { $_.PSObject.Properties.Value }) -join ', ') = $($o.result.PSObject.Properties.Value)" } catch {} } }; $seen[$p] = $lines.Count } } }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250 }

tasks.label: LiteBox: Tail Audit Log (Pretty)
args: $dir = 'C:\src\litebox\target\litebox-audit'; Write-Host 'Watching audit logs in:' $dir -ForegroundColor DarkGray; $seen = @{}; $labels = @{}; $nextLabel = 0; while ($true) { if (Test-Path $dir) { Get-ChildItem $dir -Filter '*.jsonl' | Sort-Object Name | ForEach-Object { $p = $_.FullName; if (-not $seen.ContainsKey($p)) { $seen[$p] = (Get-Content $p).Count; $lbl = [char]([int][char]'A' + ($nextLabel++ % 26)); $labels[$p] = $lbl; Write-Host "[$lbl] New session: $($_.Name)" -ForegroundColor Cyan }; $lbl = $labels[$p]; $lines = Get-Content $p; if ($lines.Count -gt $seen[$p]) { $lines[$seen[$p]..($lines.Count-1)] | & 'C:\src\litebox\litebox_tool_executor\scripts\View-AuditLog.ps1' -Prefix "[$lbl] "; $seen[$p] = $lines.Count } } }; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 250 }
